chapter: Return to New Orleans and Sharkey
title: The Silver Slipper and the Dream Room
summary: Allen asks about the Silver Slipper; Pecora cannot say when the name changed.

story.theme_name: Dance halls, lake camps and riverboat bandstands
story.community_name: Dance halls, lake resorts and where bands played

blocks.x: Did you ever work at the Silver Slipper before it was the Dream Room? No, no.
You never were there? No, I got the Casino Royale. Yeah, I was trying to keep it straight.
I didn't remember when they changed the name to the Dream Room.
Yeah. Something like it's a... DM? Oh, I can't tell you what it is. They changed the name.
